prompt: Design a weekend project for me (or my child) that combines three subjects, with check-up questions at the end.

muc.title: Real life isn't split into subjects
muc.text: Math class for math, geography class for geography, English class for English. But in real life, what task needs just one subject?

muc.title: One trip, four subjects
muc.text: Planning a trip to Da Lat takes math to work out the cost, geography to choose the route, English if you meet foreign visitors, and teamwork skills.

muc.title: Integrated learning
muc.text: That's integrated learning: learning several subjects at once through a real project. Many schools call it project-based learning.

muc.title: Knowing what it's for
muc.text: Knowledge tied to a real task is easier to remember, and you see right away what you're learning it for.

muc.title: Breaking a project into steps
muc.text: The hardest part is designing a good project. AI is great at this: it suggests a project, breaks it into steps, and notes which subject each step teaches.

muc.title: AI as the teacher for each subject
muc.text: As you work, AI plays the teacher for each subject: sometimes checking your cost math, sometimes fixing your English, sometimes asking why you chose that route.

muc.title: The whole series in one picture
muc.text: The whole series: doing beats watching, turning videos and lectures into exercises, letting AI ask you back, and integrated learning through projects.

muc.title: A weekend project
muc.text: Message AI: design a weekend project for me or my child that combines three subjects, with check-up questions at the end. Thanks for following the whole series.
